answer_1.quote: We run experiments with the WIT 3 public dataset of TED talks, with four language pairs: English-German (en-de), English-French (en-fr), English-Italian (en-it) and English-Spanish (en-es)...
answer_1.outputs: Translated sentences in the target language

answer_2.quote: We use the BLEU score to evaluate translation accuracy.

answer_4.quote: Then, we asked 3 professional translators to grade the quality of translation produced with the labels T7 and T3 on the TED talks. The evaluation is on a 1-6 scale (higher is better)...
answer_4.guideline: Rate translation quality on a 1-6 scale
